messages:
Alex: quick sync — need to decide ownership for reservoir burst path vs control-plane rateband fallback. who owns accounting, telemetry, and emergency fallback?
Mira: short answer: orch owns admission + immediate fallback; control-plane owns policy + reconciliation. but we need a compact API.
Sam: +1. also we keep seeing prewarm credits consumed but not reconciled when operator evicts — surprise bills. :grimacing:
Jia: make it explicit: operator emits `lease_evicted` with refund_hint so control-plane can settle.
Luis: who enforces if operator fails to emit? kube restarts were flaky last month.
Alex: propose dual-write: operator writes local ledger + emits event. control-plane verifies by pulling operator ledger via admin API and reconciles mismatches.
Mira: dual-write ok, add reconciliation TTL + safe-mode: if recon fails >5m, route admissions through conservative rateband (no bursts).
Sam: ops ok but SLA impact. need SLA-trigger alerts for degraded path.
Jia: minimal operator API sketch:
POST /operator/v1/leases { tenant, lease_id, credits_used, status }
GET  /operator/v1/ledger?since=ts
POST /operator/v1/webhook/refund_hint { lease_id, refund_amount }
Alex: keep it tiny. control-plane polls GET ledger and reconciles every minute.
Luis: prewarm tokens: operator has local pool; when low it requests replenish via `acquire_headroom` RPC.
Mira: tradeoff: sync acquire increases tail latency. prefer async with best-effort fastpath: operator may borrow ephemeral tokens then reconcile.
Sam: ephemeral window bounds: suggest ephemeral=2 tokens max per instance, leak rate 1 token/30s.
Jia: add circuit-breaker: if >ephemeral_limit for 2m, flip to degraded admission + alert.
Alex: telemetry events: `admit_attempt`, `admit_success`, `ephemeral_used`, `reconcile_status`. control-plane emits `refund_processed`, `ledger_mismatch`. aim for mismatch rate <0.1%.
Luis: billing: control-plane canonical billing; operator ledger is advisory. reconciled diffs billed by canonical sequence.
Mira: who owns fallback model routing? orch can route to cheaper variant instantly but policy comes from control-plane.
Sam: policy stored in control-plane; operator caches with TTL=30s and honors it. control-plane can push revokes.
Jia: i'll write an RFC for `operator-admin-api` with endpoints + error semantics tomorrow.
Alex: action items: Jia RFC stub, Mira add SLOs & alerts, Sam draft ephemeral limits & billing note, Luis add reconciliation playbook. I will open a PR for operator endpoints.
Mira: add test harness for ledger-disagreement simulations — caught lots of bugs.
orch-bot: deploy-bot: note api-proto branch added `lease_evicted.refund_hint`. CI: 1 failing test.
Sam: i'll triage CI after lunch.
Alex: thanks — keep small updates here. :thumbsup:
